title: Towards a Digital Twin for the Ground to QEYSSat Quantum Link
summary: Simulations of physical systems require high-fidelity models to accurately represent reality. Simple models may be analytically tractable, but may not be sufficiently representative of reality for the given application. The cost of this simplicity is accuracy, or in the case of quantum key distribution, provable security. Sources of this accuracy gap include the difficulty of modelling physical effects which do not lend themselves well to analytical descriptions, such as afterpulsing.
